bio.text: Sylvia Allen is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 7; the Navajo County Board of Supervisors appointed her on April 28, 2026, to replace David Marshall, and she assumed office on April 29, 2026.
She represented District 5 in the Arizona Senate from 2008 to 2013 and District 6 from 2015 to 2021, and served as Senate president pro tempore.
She was born in Phoenix and worked as a real estate agent at Integrity Realty before serving in the Legislature.
She chaired the Navajo County Republican Party from 2000 to 2005.
